title: Item:Crystal Cove Wands

=== Wands ===
All [[wand]]s created with Euphonia's Barter Box have 10 [[Wand#Charges|charges]] and produce the effect of [[Knock]] with varying [[caster level]]s. These are typically not worth it because they cannot unlock most locks on elite at level.
